definitions.explanation: One's grandfather and grandmother collectively. A compound of {祖父|そふ} (grandfather) and {祖母|そぼ} (grandmother).

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}の{家|いえ}に{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to visit my grandparents' house.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みは{祖父母|そふぼ}と{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent the summer vacation with my grandparents.

examples.japanese: {祖父母|そふぼ}からお{年玉|としだま}をもらった。
examples.english: I received New Year's money from my grandparents.

notes:
FAMILY TERMS:
- {祖父|そふ} (grandfather - formal)
- {祖母|そぼ} (grandmother - formal)
- {祖父母|そふぼ} (grandparents)
- おじいさん (grandfather - common/polite)
- おばあさん (grandmother - common/polite)

USAGE: {祖父母|そふぼ} is more formal and is commonly used when talking about grandparents in general or in written contexts. In casual speech, おじいちゃんとおばあちゃん is more common.

RELATED TERMS:
- {父母|ふぼ} (parents - formal)
- {両親|りょうしん} (parents)
